resolved_findings.title: Scoring lacks direct checks against frozen model and test-data fingerprints
resolved_findings.evidence: evaluate_final.py checks execution.status and base/manifest path order, but does not compare best.pt to execution.checkpoint_sha256 or compare evaluation manifests/base inventories to preflight file_sha256 before scoring.
resolved_findings.consequence: The claimed fixed-model/frozen-test scoring is a procedural assumption rather than an enforced artifact contract. Current frozen files are unchanged; no actual mismatch was found.
resolved_findings.minimal_fix: Before scoring, verify execution completed/epochs20, best SHA equals execution SHA, audited manifest/base/config fingerprints remain unchanged, and current eval cache files match their recorded prepared SHA. Store the loaded model SHA and ensure it remains unchanged through scoring.
